factTypes.title: Fact types
factTypes.description: Which kinds of facts to include. "Selected" are events hand-picked by Wikipedia editors and usually the most interesting.

randomize.title: Random pick
randomize.description: Pick facts randomly. When off, facts keep Wikipedia's order (newest first) and alternate between the selected types.

language.title: Wikipedia language
language.description: Language code of the Wikipedia edition, e.g. en, de, fr, sv. Not every edition provides the "On this day" feed.

date.title: Date
date.description: Leave empty for today. Otherwise use YYYY-MM-DD or MM-DD.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA timezone used to decide what "today" is, e.g. Europe/Prague or America/New_York.
